summary.text: Elvis Clark is the Republican candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 41, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Democrat Mark Gamba.

paragraphs.text: Clark has run for this seat before: he lost the 2022 Republican primary to Robert Reynolds, then advanced from the 2024 Republican primary and lost the November 2024 general election to Gamba.
